本校植物系退休副教授周惠慈女士之子張其善先生，為紀念其母並獎勵清寒優秀學生完成學業， 特捐贈國立中興大學新台幣陸拾萬元整，設置「國立中興大學周惠慈副教授紀念獎學金」。 Mr. Chang Chi-Shan, the son of Ms. Chou Hui-Tzu, a retired associate professor of the Department of Plant Pathology at this university, has donated NT$600,000 to National Chung Hsing University to commemorate his mother and to support outstanding students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds in completing their studies. This fund is designated as the "National Chung Hsing University Assistant Professor Chou Hui-Tzu Memorial Scholarship. 金額 /名額 Award/Quota 1萬5千元 / 2名 NT$15,000 / 2 recipients 申請資格 Eligibility 1.本國籍之本校 生命科學系大學部在學學生 undergraduate students of the Department of Life Sciences who are Taiwanese 2.單親家庭子女或家境清寒 applicant is from single-parent families or financially disadvantaged backgrounds 3.該學期獲獎前無休、退、轉學者 applicant must not have taken a leave of absence, withdrawn, or transferred schools in the semester before the application 申請方式 Application Procedure 備齊所需文件至本校生輔組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請 Submit the required documents to the Student Life Division at our university (2nd Floor, Hui-Sun Auditorium). 必備文件 Required Documents 1.申請表+成績單 Application Form + Transcript 2.單親家庭子女或家境清寒證明 Proof of single-parent family status or financial disadvantage. 收件日期 Deadline 115年11月2日至11月20日17時止 From November 2, 2026, to November 20, 2026, 5:00 PM. 洽詢方式 Contact 電話：04-22840663 生輔組 Number: 04-2284-0663, Student Life Division 備註 Notes ◎本獎學金由接受各界捐助獎助學金管理委員會審核，該委員會審核會議預計115年12月底召開。 The scholarship will be awarded after review and approval by the Scholarship Management Committee of the university. ◎轉學生用前學校最後一學年成績申請。 Transfer students should use their final academic year grades from their previous school for the application. 常用資料 取得方法 How to obtain Commonly Used information ◎成績證明：註冊組外的自動繳費列印機 Transcript: Available from the automatic payment printer at the Registration Office. attachment_texts.text: 國立中興大學周惠慈副教授紀念獎助學金授與辦法 National Chung Hsing University Assistant Professor Chou Hui-Tzu Memorial Scholarship Regulations 106.01.06 接受各界捐助獎助學金管理委員會會議訂定 Established by the Scholarships Fund Management Committee on January 6, 2017 107.12.27 接受各界捐助獎助學金管理委員會會議修正 Revised by the Scholarships Fund Management Committee on December 27, 2018 第一條 本校植物系退休副教授周惠慈女士之子張其善先生，為紀念其母並獎勵 清寒優秀學生完成學業，特捐贈國立中興大學新台幣陸拾萬元整，設置 「國立中興大學周惠慈副教授紀念獎學金」 。 Article 1 Mr. Chang Chi-Shan, the son of Ms. Chou Hui-Tzu, a retired associate professor of the Department of Plant Pathology at this university, has donated NT$600,000 to National Chung Hsing University to commemorate his mother and to support outstanding students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds in completing their studies. This fund is designated as the "National Chung Hsing University Assistant Professor Chou Hui-Tzu Memorial Scholarship. 第二條 每學年授與獎助學金人數為二名。 Article 2 The scholarship will be awarded to tw o students each academic year. 第三條 每名授與新臺幣壹萬伍千元。 Article 3 Each recipient will be awarded NT$15,000. 第四條 申請資格為本國籍之本校生命科學系大學部在學學生，並同時為單親家 庭子女或家境清寒，且該學期獲獎前無休、退、轉學者。 Article 4 Eligibility for application is limited to undergraduate students of the Department of Life Sciences at this university who are Taiwanese nationals, and who are from single-parent families or financially disadvantaged backgrounds. Additionally, applicants must not have taken a leave of absence, withdrawn, or transferred schools in the semester prior to the application. 第五條 繳交文件： 一、申請書。 二、單親家庭子女或家境清寒證明。 Article 5 Required documents: 1. Application form. 2. Proof of single-parent family status or financial disadvantage. 第六條 每學年依公告日期至生輔組提出申請。 Article 6 Applications must be submitted to the Student Affairs Office by the announced deadline each academic year. 第七條 本獎學金經本校接受各界捐助獎助學金管理委員會會議審核後授與。 Article 7 The scholarship will be awarded after review and approval by the Scholarship Management Committee of the university. 第八條 學生獲獎紀錄永久保存，申請資料則保存 1 年。 Article 8 Records of scholarship awards will be permanently maintained, while application materials will be kept for one year. 第九條 本辦法經本校接受各界捐助獎助學金管理委員會會議通過，陳請校長核 定後實施，修正時亦同。 Article 9 These regulations will be implemented after being approved by the Scholarships Fund Management Committee and the university president. The same procedure applies to any amendments.

an average academic and conduct score of 85 or above for the previous semester, with no failing grades. 2.本學期 已領其他獎助學金 者，不得申請。 Students who have received other scholarships this semester are not eligible to apply. 3.在職生及延畢生不得申請。 Part-time students or delayed graduation students are not eligible to apply. 4.中低收入戶或家境清寒之學生優先獲獎 。 Preference will be given to students from low and near-poor household and those with financial hardship. 申請方式 Application Procedure 備齊所需文件至本校生輔組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請 Submit the required documents to the Student Life Division (2nd Floor, Hui-Sun Auditorium) at our status and financial hardship must be included for relevant applicants. 收件期間 Deadline 11月 2日至 11月 20日 17時止 11/02 ~ 11/20, 5:00 PM. 洽詢方式 Contact 電話：04-22840663 蕭小姐 Phone: 04-2284-0663, Ms. Hsiao 備註 university, which will be used for student scholarships. 金額/ 名額 Award/Quota 1萬元/ 10名 NT$10,000 per recipient / 10 recipients 申請資格 Eligibility 1.申請者前一學期學業及操行成績平均85分以上，且未有任何一科不及格者。 Applicants must have status and financial hardship must be included for relevant applicants. 收件期間 Deadline 11月 2日至 11月 20日 17時止 11/02 ~ 11/20, 5:00 PM. 洽詢方式 Contact 電話：04-22840663 蕭小姐 Phone: 04-2284-0663, Ms. Hsiao 備註 attachment_texts.text: 申請個人所得清單方式 請申請父、母或家中主要經濟來源者的個人所得清單 方法一：臨櫃辦理請至 「財政部各區國稅局 「各政府地方稅務局」 ◆本人辦理─攜帶本人的身份證和印章 ◆委託他人辦理─攜帶申請人和委託人的身份證和印章、委任書(國稅局網站可下載) 方法二：線上申辦自行列印請依以下步驟操作 先準備：自然人憑證或健保卡、讀卡機、電腦 或 步驟1：到「財政部稅務入口網」https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/，進入「線上服 務」，找到「電子稅務文件」 步驟2：進入「線上申請」 步驟3：找到個人所得資料─依照您讀卡機插入的卡來選擇「自然人憑證」或「健保卡」 步驟4：登入個人資料(身份證字號、自然人憑證pin 碼、驗證碼) 用「自然人憑證」登入畫面 用「健保卡」登入畫面 不知道健保卡註冊密碼，請先到「健保卡網路註冊」 https://cloudicweb.nhi.gov.tw/cloudic/System/mLogin.aspx 步驟5：勾選「112」年度、「補助」 、 「學校」和填聯絡人資訊 輸入健保卡 註冊密碼 姓名 身份證字號 112 申請財產資 料方式和個 人所得資料 相同 以下教學是 申請個人所 得的方式 步驟6：約半小時後，會收到「電子稅務文件案件結案通知」 輸入 e-mail 後， 再按此鍵 收到信件驗證碼 後，再按此鍵 完成聯絡人資訊， 再按此鍵 按此鍵，直接連結 到進度查詢 步驟7：回到財政部稅務入口網─進度查詢，點選案件編號 步驟8：按「下載稅務文件及簽章檔」 按這個 按這個下載文件 步驟9：下載後，請先解壓縮，再點選文件。密碼請輸入身份證字號（英文字要大寫） 步驟10：列印文件，家中沒有印表機，可利用7-11 的ibon 或全家Famiport 的雲端列印 7-11 的ibon 雲端列印：google 搜尋「ibon 列印」或按以下連結 7-11 的ibon 雲端列印網：https://print.ibon.com.tw/ibonprinter 解壓縮後，點這個 輸入身份證字號， 英文開頭要大寫 輸入電子郵件 上傳檔案 要勾選 或到信箱收信 步驟11：到7-11 超商找到ibon，輸入取件編號，依步驟說明操作，文件開啟前也要輸入密 碼（身份證字號，英文字要大寫） 請記住取件編號 共 10 碼 步驟10： 全家的Famiport 雲端列印：google 搜尋「全家列印」或按以下連結 全家的雲端列印網：https://www.famiport.com.tw/Web_Famiport/page/cloudprint.aspx 輸入電子郵件 上傳檔案 要勾選 上傳成功後 請記住取件編號 共 10 碼 或到信箱收信 步驟11：到全家超商找到Famiport，輸入取件編號，依步驟說明操作，文件開啟前也要輸 入密碼（身份證字號，英文字要大寫） 請記住取件編號 共 10 碼

ONLY) 公告 somia 校內獎助學金 2026-09-17 25901 設立宗旨 Purpose of Establishment 本校為獎勵清寒勤奮向學之學生，特設立清寒勤學獎助學金。 To reward diligent students from financially disadvantaged backgrounds, our university has established the Scholarship for Financial Hardship and Diligent Study. 金額 Award 每名2萬元 20,000 TWD per recipient 名額 Quota 每學年發給 以不超過75名為原則 Each academic year, no more than 75 students will receive a scholarship. 申請資格 Eligibility A類： 大學部：前學期學業成績班上前百分之五十以內 ；操行成績平均85分以上且無不良紀錄(新生免計操行)。 Undergraduate: Must be in the top 50% of the class based on the previous semester's academic performance; average conduct score of 85 or above with no misconduct record (conduct score not required for new students). 研究所：前學期學業成績平均80分以上；操行成績平均85分以上且無不良紀錄 (新生免計操行) 。 Graduate: Average academic score of 80 or above for the previous semester; average conduct score of 85 or above with no misconduct record (conduct score not required for new students). 家庭年收入低於90萬元、利息所得低於5千元且家庭財產總額(不含存款)低於300萬元和車輛1台以內者 。若因高利率存款致利息年所得逾新台幣5千元或已無存款者，得檢附相關證明由學校審核認定。 Family annual income below 900,000 TWD, interest income below 5,000 TWD, and total family assets (excluding savings) below 3,000,000 TWD with a maximum of 1 car. If high-interest savings result in interest income exceeding 5,000 TWD annually or if there are no savings, relevant proof must be submitted for review and verification by the university. 延修生或因修習雙主修、輔系而延長就學、 已領其他獎助學金2萬元以上者 及 每學年享有就學優待達2萬元以上 者不得申請。 Students who have extended their study period due to double majors or minors, have received other scholarships exceeding 20,000 TWD, or have annual educational benefits exceeding 20,000 TWD are not eligible to apply. 須具有中華民國國籍 (僑生另依清寒僑生獎助辦法向學安室提出申請)。 Must be a citizen of Taiwanese (overseas students should apply according to the financial hardship scholarship regulations for overseas students through the Office of International Affairs). 新生用前畢業學校或同等學歷 成績單 申請。 New students should use transcripts from their previous school or equivalent qualifications to apply. B類： 1.低收入戶學生及中低收入戶學生。 Students from low-income households and students from lower-middle-income households. 2.研究所前學期學業成績平均80分（含）以上，大學部則為班上前百分之五十以內，操行成績平均85分（含）以上。 Graduate students must have an average academic grade of 80 or above in the previous semester; undergraduates must be in the top 50% of their class with an average conduct grade of 85 or above. 3.已領其他獎助學金2萬元(含)以上者，不得申請。 Students who receive more than 20,000 yuan in educational subsidies per academic year are not eligible to apply. 申請方式 Application Procedure 申請書請至生活輔導組網頁下載 Download the application form from the Student Life Division website. 備齊所需文件至本校生活輔導組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請 Submit the completed documents to the Student Life Division (2nd Floor, Hui-Sun Auditorium) at our university. 必備文件 Required Document A類： 申請書及 並 填報google表單 。 Application Form.+ the Google form online . 114-2成績單(新生以畢業學校平均成績申請， 大學部學生需附 成績排名 ) Official transcript for the semester 114-1 (new students should provide the average grades from their previous school; undergraduate students must include class ranking). 114年家庭成員所得清單證明 Proof of family income list for 2025 year. 114年家庭成員財產證明 Proof of family assets for 2025 year. 3個月內戶籍謄本(記事欄勿省略) Household registration transcripts (within 3 copies, ensure the Notes-column section is not omitted). 家境清寒證明 Proof of financial disadvantage. 21943 設立 宗旨 Purpose of Establishment 為獎助在校學生學業品行優越者或經濟上需要協助者，使其順利完成學業，設置南加州校友會獎學金。 This scholarship is established to reward students with excellent academic and conduct performance or those who need financial assistance to complete their studies successfully. 金額 Amount 1000 美元 等值之新台幣(依本校換算成台幣後之實際金額給付) 1,000 USD equivalent in NTD(the actual amount paid based on the exchange rate at the disbursement). 名額 Quota 3名(最終依南加州校友會審核決議而定) 3 (Final determination is subject to the review and approval of the Southern California Alumni Association). 申請 資格 Eligibility 1.本校大學部二年級至四年級學生。 Undergraduate students in their second to fourth year. 2.成績優良，具有原創性研發潛力者及經濟上需協助者。 Students with excellent academic performance, original research potential, or financial need. 申請 方式 Application Method 備齊所需文件至本校生輔組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請 Submit the required documents to the Student Life Division at our university (2nd Floor, Hui-Sun Auditorium). 申請 必備 文件 Required Documents 一、獎學金申請書及最近半身相片1張。 Scholarship application form and one recent half-length photo. 二、歷年成績單。 Academic transcripts from all years of study. 三、自傳及生涯規劃。 Autobiography and career plan. 四、推薦信二封。 Two letters of recommendation. 五、符合下列資格之一者，可申請。 低收入戶證明。 學生本人及父母所得+戶籍資料。 家中收入因故銳減證明。 Proof of financial need (choose one of the following): Low-income household certificate Income and household registration documents of the student and parents Proof of a significant reduction in family income 六、非必備：其他有助於審查文件(例如：任何創作–報章期刊有刊登的) Optional: Any additional documents that may support the review process (e.g., published creative works in newspapers or journals). 收件截止日：6 月 10 日 至 8月 14 日 17 時止 (郵寄者，以郵戳為憑) A pplication Period: 06/10 ~ 08/14 (until 17:00). Applications submitted by mail will be considered based on the postmark date. 洽詢方式：04-22871084 蕭小姐 Contact: 04-22871084, Ms.Hsiao 備註 Notes ◎本獎學金由南加州校友會獎學金委員會審查，獎學金將於校慶前匯入獲獎者帳戶， 並於每年校慶時由回校參加校慶的理事或委員進行公開表揚。 The Southern California Alumni Association Scholarship Committee is responsible for the review process. Disadvantaged Scholarship Application dates : 9/22~9/30(For TAIWANESE students ONLY) 公告 somia 校內獎助學金 2026-08-31 3644 設立宗旨 Purpose of Establishment 達達國際企業股份有限公司（Lagoon）董事長劉保佑先生，為鼓勵經濟弱勢學子，激發其向上精神，順利完成學業，特設置「國立中興大學達達國際企業股份有限公司（Lagoon）弱勢獎學金」。 Mr. Liu Bao-you, Chairman of Lagoon International Enterprise Co., Ltd., has established the "National Chung Hsing University Lagoon International Enterprise Co., Ltd. Disadvantaged Scholarship" to encourage students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, inspire their perseverance, and support them in their studies. 金額/名額 Amount/ Quota 6萬元/10名 NT$60,000 per recipient/ 10 recipients 申請資格 Eligibility Criteria 一、本校本國籍大學部在學學生(含大一新生；不含公費生)且有低收入戶、中低收入戶或特殊境遇家庭子女證明。 Applicants must be domestic undergraduate students of the university (including first-year students; excluding government-sponsored students) and must provide proof of being from a low-income, lower-middle-income, or special circumstance family. 二、未領取政府各類學雜費減免優待補助、政府各項獎助學金(學校學雜費減免者，不在此限)及軍公教子女教育補助費者。 Applicants must not be receiving any government tuition waivers, government scholarships, or educational subsidies for children of military, public service, or teaching personnel (except for those receiving tuition waivers from the university). 申請方式 Application Method 備齊所需文件至本校生輔組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請 S ubmit the required documents to the Student Life Division (2nd Floor, Hui-Sung Hall). 必備文件 Required Document 申請表。 Application form.並填寫 GOOGL表單 fill out google form 前一學年附名次成績單正本 1 份（新生免附）。 Official transcript from the previous academic year, including class ranking (not required for first-year students). 3個月內戶籍謄本。 Copy of household registration certificate or household registration transcript. 收件截止日：115 年 9 月 22 日 至 9 月 30 日 17 時止 Submission Period: 9/22~9/30 洽詢方式：04-22871084 蕭小姐 Contact: 04-22871084, Ms. Hsiao 備註 Note ◎獎助學金採帳戶匯款方式，於上、下學期各發放 1 次，發放時間、獲獎名單及領獎方式，屆時公告於本校網站並個別通知獲獎同學需出席頒獎典禮，若無正當理由而未參加者，則停發獎學金。 Scholarships will be disbursed twice per academic year via bank transfer. The distribution schedule, list of recipients, and award collection process will be announced on the university website. Recipients must attend the award ceremony, and failure to attend without a valid reason will result in scholarship cancellation. ◎得獎同學應於獲獎當學年第二學期3月31日前提供第一學期成績單及得獎心得 1 篇(不得少於1,000字)，審查委員會將視得獎學生學習狀況評估第二學期是否繼續提供獎學金。 Scholarship recipients must submit their first-semester transcript and a reflection essay (minimum 1,000 words) by March 31 of the second semester. The review committee will then assess their academic performance to determine whether the scholarship will continue for the second semester. 常用資料 取得方法 How to obtain Commonly Used information ◎成績證明：註冊組的自動繳費列印機 Transcript: Automatic payment printer at the Registration Office. ◎戶籍謄本：向戶政事務所 Household registration transcripts: Please request from the Household Registration Office. Purpose of Establishment 社團法人國立中興大學校友總會為鼓勵學子勤學向善，設立校友總會獎學金。 The Alumni Association of National Chung Hsing University, ROC (hereinafter referred to as "the Association") establishes these regulations to encourage students to pursue diligence and virtue in their studies. 金額 Amount 每名 1 萬 5 仟元 Each scholarship award is NT$15,000. 名額 Quota 15 名 15 recipients. 申請 資格 Eligibility Criteria 1. 前一學期學業成績達 70 分以上，操行成績達 80 分以上 。 An academic average of 70 or above and a conduct score of 80 or above in the previous semester. 2. 家境清寒或政府登記之低收入戶 。 Financially disadvantaged or registered as a low-income household. 3. 家中收入因故銳減致生活困苦、遭重大變故亟需急難救助。 Significant reduction in family income due to unforeseen circumstances or major incidents. 4. 優秀博士班清寒研究生出席國外研討會公開口頭發表論文。 Outstanding financially disadvantaged doctoral students presenting papers at international conferences. 申請方式 Application Method 備齊所需文件至本校生輔組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請。 Submit the required documents to the Student Life Divisionat our university (2nd Floor, Hui-Sun Auditorium). 申請必備 文件 Required Documents 1. 申請表 。 Application form 2. 前一學期成績單。 Transcript from the previous semester. 3. 低收入戶證明 ( 或 清寒 證明 ) +114 年度家庭個人所得清單（含學生本人及父母） + 3個月內 戶籍謄本。 Proof of low-income household status (or proof of financial hardship) and a list of personal income for the previous year (including the applicant and their parents). 4. 家中收入因故銳減或遭重大變故需急難救助證明。 Proof of significant reduction in family income due to unforeseen circumstances or major incidents. 5. 研討會論文接受函及推薦函二封（內容須包含被推薦人的研究品質、外語能力、 被推薦人擬參加的國際會議之重要性，以及此國際會議對被推薦人的未來學術發展所產生之影響等） 或其他相關有利佐證資料。 Conference paper acceptance letter and two recommendation letters (which should include the applicant's research quality, foreign language ability, the importance of the international conference to be attended, and the potential impact of the conference on the applicant's future academic development), or other relevant supporting documents. ◎ 第 3 至5 項擇一申請 。 收件截止日：115年 10 月 8 日 17 時止 Deadline: 2026/10/08 5:00 PM. 洽詢方式：04-22840663 蕭小姐 Contact: 04-22840663 Ms. Hsiao 備註 ◎獎學金將匯入獲獎者帳戶，並於校友總會每年會員大會進行公開表揚。 The scholarship funds will be transferred to the recipients' accounts, and t he Alumni Association of National Chung Hsing University will hold a public recognition ceremony at a later date. ◎轉學生用前學校最後一學期成績單申請。 Transfer students should apply with their last semester's transcript from their previous school. 資料 取得 方式 ◎成績證明：註冊組的自動繳費列印機。 Transcript: Available from the automatic payment printer at the Registration Office. ◎ 清寒證明：向戶籍地村里長申請。 P roof of financial disadvantage: Please submit a request to ◎所得證明：請向各地區國稅局申請。 Income and asset proof: Request from the local National Tax Bureau. ※線上查調個人財產或所得→電子稅務文件入口網 (nat.gov.tw) Comprehensive Guide to Checking Property and Income ※ 申請個人所得及財產清單方式 ◎ Purpose of Establishment 社團法人國立中興大學校友總會為鼓勵學子勤學向善，設立校友總會獎學金。 The Alumni Association of National Chung Hsing University, ROC (hereinafter referred to as "the Association") establishes these regulations to encourage students to pursue diligence and virtue in their studies. 金額 Amount 每名 1 萬 5 仟元 Each scholarship award is NT$15,000. 名額 Quota 15 名 15 recipients. 申請 資格 Eligibility Criteria 1. 前一學期學業成績達 70 分以上，操行成績達 80 分以上 。 An academic average of 70 or above and a conduct score of 80 or above in the previous semester. 2. 家境清寒或政府登記之低收入戶 。 Financially disadvantaged or registered as a low-income household. 3. 家中收入因故銳減致生活困苦、遭重大變故亟需急難救助。 Significant reduction in family income due to unforeseen circumstances or major incidents. 4. 優秀博士班清寒研究生出席國外研討會公開口頭發表論文。 Outstanding financially disadvantaged doctoral students presenting papers at international conferences. 申請方式 Application Method 備齊所需文件至本校生輔組(惠蓀堂2樓)申請。 Submit the required documents to the Student Life Divisionat our university (2nd Floor, Hui-Sun Auditorium). 申請必備 文件 Required Documents 1. 申請表 。 Application form 2. 前一學期成績單。 Transcript from the previous semester. 3. 低收入戶證明 ( 或 清寒 證明 ) +114 年度家庭個人所得清單（含學生本人及父母） + 3個月內 戶籍謄本。 Proof of low-income household status (or proof of financial hardship) and a list of personal income for the previous year (including the applicant and their parents). 4. 家中收入因故銳減或遭重大變故需急難救助證明。 Proof of significant reduction in family income due to unforeseen circumstances or major incidents. 5. 研討會論文接受函及推薦函二封（內容須包含被推薦人的研究品質、外語能力、 被推薦人擬參加的國際會議之重要性，以及此國際會議對被推薦人的未來學術發展所產生之影響等） 或其他相關有利佐證資料。 Conference paper acceptance letter and two recommendation letters (which should include the applicant's research quality, foreign language ability, the importance of the international conference to be attended, and the potential impact of the conference on the applicant's future academic development), or other relevant supporting documents. ◎ 第 3 至5 項擇一申請 。 收件截止日：115年 10 月 8 日 17 時止 Deadline: 2026/10/08 5:00 National Chung Hsing University will hold a public recognition ceremony at a later date. ◎轉學生用前學校最後一學期成績單申請。 Transfer students should apply with their last semester's transcript from their previous attachment_texts.text: 申請個人所得清單方式 請申請父、母或家中主要經濟來源者的個人所得清單 方法一：臨櫃辦理請至 「財政部各區國稅局 「各政府地方稅務局」 ◆本人辦理─攜帶本人的身份證和印章 ◆委託他人辦理─攜帶申請人和委託人的身份證和印章、委任書(國稅局網站可下載) 方法二：線上申辦自行列印請依以下步驟操作 先準備：自然人憑證或健保卡、讀卡機、電腦 或 步驟1：到「財政部稅務入口網」https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/，進入「線上服 務」，找到「電子稅務文件」 步驟2：進入「線上申請」 步驟3：找到個人所得資料─依照您讀卡機插入的卡來選擇「自然人憑證」或「健保卡」 步驟4：登入個人資料(身份證字號、自然人憑證pin 碼、驗證碼) 用「自然人憑證」登入畫面 用「健保卡」登入畫面 不知道健保卡註冊密碼，請先到「健保卡網路註冊」 https://cloudicweb.nhi.gov.tw/cloudic/System/mLogin.aspx 步驟5：勾選「112」年度、「補助」 、 「學校」和填聯絡人資訊 輸入健保卡 註冊密碼 姓名 身份證字號 112 申請財產資 料方式和個 人所得資料 相同 以下教學是 申請個人所 得的方式 步驟6：約半小時後，會收到「電子稅務文件案件結案通知」 輸入 e-mail 後， 再按此鍵 收到信件驗證碼 後，再按此鍵 完成聯絡人資訊， 再按此鍵 按此鍵，直接連結 到進度查詢 步驟7：回到財政部稅務入口網─進度查詢，點選案件編號 步驟8：按「下載稅務文件及簽章檔」 按這個 按這個下載文件 步驟9：下載後，請先解壓縮，再點選文件。密碼請輸入身份證字號（英文字要大寫） 步驟10：列印文件，家中沒有印表機，可利用7-11 的ibon 或全家Famiport 的雲端列印 7-11 的ibon 雲端列印：google 搜尋「ibon 列印」或按以下連結 7-11 的ibon 雲端列印網：https://print.ibon.com.tw/ibonprinter 解壓縮後，點這個 輸入身份證字號， 英文開頭要大寫 輸入電子郵件 上傳檔案 要勾選 或到信箱收信 步驟11：到7-11 超商找到ibon，輸入取件編號，依步驟說明操作，文件開啟前也要輸入密 碼（身份證字號，英文字要大寫） 請記住取件編號 共 10 碼 步驟10： 全家的Famiport 雲端列印：google 搜尋「全家列印」或按以下連結 全家的雲端列印網：https://www.famiport.com.tw/Web_Famiport/page/cloudprint.aspx 輸入電子郵件 上傳檔案 要勾選 上傳成功後 請記住取件編號 共 10 碼 或到信箱收信 步驟11：到全家超商找到Famiport，輸入取件編號，依步驟說明操作，文件開啟前也要輸 入密碼（身份證字號，英文字要大寫） 請記住取件編號 共 10 碼

The scholarship will be reviewed by the Hsing-Yi Scholarship Review Committee, which is expected to hold its meeting at the end of November 2026. 領有本項獎學金者，請 於期末考前1個月繳交出席證明及致捐款人200字以上親筆感謝函（僅需於第1學期提供一次） 至學務處生輔組。 Recipients of this scholarship must submit proof of attendance and a handwritten thank-you letter of at least 200 words to the donors (only required once during the first semester) to the Student Life Division one month before the end-of-term exams. 領有本項獎學金者，續領條件為： 每學期成績總平均 60分以上或班排名前50%，且需參加高教深耕輔導活動至少10小時以上 ，高教深耕時數證明自第2個學期起需於開學後6週內繳交出席證明至學務處生輔組。 To continue receiving this scholarship, recipients must meet the following conditions: - Maintain a semester GPA of at least 60 or rank in the top 50% of the class. - Participate in at least 10 hours of Higher Education Program counseling activities.
